title: Two tasks, one repository
intro: You're building a feature in one session and want a second session to fix a bug at the same time. Pick how you start the second one.

show.title: Edits can collide
show.detail: Both sessions share the same files and branch, so one may overwrite or confuse the other's changes.

trace.text: Works in the same checkout as the first session.

show.title: Isolated copy
show.detail: Claude Code creates .claude/worktrees/bugfix on its own branch. The two sessions can't touch each other's files.

trace.text: Creates the worktree on branch worktree-bugfix.

show.title: Start from a pull request
show.detail: The worktree is branched from pull request 1234, ready to review or continue it.

trace.text: Fetches the PR branch into a new worktree.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of the options to see what happens.

quiz.question: Your app needs a .env file that git ignores. How does it get into a new worktree?
options: It can't be used in worktrees
quiz.explanation: Files listed in .worktreeinclude (gitignore syntax) are copied into new worktrees.
